title.narrative: Sustaining Malaria Control Interventions and Transition to Malaria Elimination in Ethiopia - Ethiopia (01-Jul-2024-30-Jun-2027)

description.narrative: Ethiopia, Malaria, Federal Ministry of Health of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia (FMOH)This program has the following goals: By June 30, 2027, reduce malaria deaths by 50 percent from the baseline of 2022/23.. By June 30, 2027, reduce malaria cases by 60 percent from the baseline of 2022/23.. By June 30, 2027, achieve zero indigenous malaria case in kebeles reporting API less than one in elimination targeted districts.. The objectives of this program are: By June 30, 2027, achieve adoption of recommended behavior regarding antimalarial interventions by 85% of households living in malaria risk areas.. By 2024 and beyond, conduct confirmatory testing for 100% of suspected malaria cases and treat all confirmed cases according to the national guidelines.. 2024 and beyond, cover 100% of eligible population living in low, moderate and high malaria risk areas with one type of globally recommended core vector control interventions.. By 2024 and beyond, conduct case and focus investigation, classification, and response in 100% kebeles located in elimination-targeted districts with one case per week per kebele.. By 2024 and beyond, generate evidence that facilitates decision-making of malaria program at all levels.. By 2024 and beyond, develop national malaria early warning system to improve epidemic preparedness, detection and response at all levels.
